tree_mesh — DRIVE terrain op

• 資料種類:無 → table(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tree_mesh(height: 'float' = 6.0, trunk_radius: 'float' = 0.15, crown_radius: 'float' = 1.8, kind: 'str' = 'broadleaf', n: 'int' = 8, color=None) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import driveterrain; driveterrain.tree_mesh(height: 'float' = 6.0, trunk_radius: 'float' = 0.15, crown_radius: 'float' = 1.8, kind: 'str' = 'broadleaf', n: 'int' = 8, color=None) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsdrive.get("tree_mesh"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

手続き的な木: 幹 = 正 n 角柱(高さ 0.35·height)、樹冠 = 円錐(conifer)か回転楕円体(broadleaf、上下 0.65·height)。

返り値 {"V", "F", "color" (M,3), "label" (13), "dims", "volume"}。volume は閉形式: 幹 = ½ n r² sin(2π/n)·h_t、円錐 = ⅓·½ n R² sin(2π/n)·h_c(多角形の底面なので厳密)、楕円体は内接なので mesh_signed_volume ≤ 4/3·π R² (h_c/2)。
